versions.changelog: Improved documentation, better error handling, multiple token location support
Initial release - usage monitoring for Z.AI GLM Coding Plan

Z.AI Usage Monitor v1.0.0

- Initial release for tracking Z.AI GLM Coding Plan usage and quota.
- Monitor 5-hour and monthly token consumption and view reset times.
- Check web tool usage, subscription status, and receive visual status icons for current usage.
- Provides scripts and setup instructions for quick usage and status checks.
- Supports simple, natural language usage queries.
